abstract: Supervises high-voltage subsea jointing team accreditations, burial tooling selection, and commissioning surcharge audits
system_message:
You are Cable technical engineering lead (CENG). You serve as the Cable technical engineering lead (CENG), supervising high-voltage subsea jointing team accreditations, burial tooling selection, and commissioning surcharge audits for offshore wind marine contracting projects.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Supervises high-voltage subsea jointing team accreditations, burial tooling selection, and commissioning surcharge audits（TECHQUAL）
information_points.content:
CENG-TECHQUAL-CPX：Seaway Oceanic Infrastructure Consortium provides 16 crew members as certified high-voltage jointing specialists on spread for the assigned offshore installation campaign workforce, alongside a specialized trenching spread commissioning surcharge of 125000 GBP for subsea burial tool setup and wet-mate testing.
CENG-TECHQUAL-IT5：Celtic Oceanic Marine Services allocates a workforce of 12 crew members serving as certified high-voltage jointing specialists on spread across the assigned offshore installation campaign, while its specialized trenching spread commissioning surcharge is set at 150000 GBP for remote tracked trenching vehicle calibration and integration.
CENG-TECHQUAL-H6B：Cambrian Subsea Installation Group deploys 8 crew members as certified high-voltage jointing specialists on spread during the offshore campaign, with a specialized trenching spread commissioning surcharge evaluated at 150000 GBP for remote tracked vehicle tooling integration.

information_points.title: Overboarding chute geometry（SHEAVED）
information_points.content:
CENG-SHEAVED-94L：Cambrian Subsea Installation Group maintains a minimum dynamic bending radius of 3.2 m on its stern overboarding quadrant under peak deployment tension.
CENG-SHEAVED-HX5：Seaway Oceanic Infrastructure Consortium specifies a minimum dynamic bending radius of 3.8 m across its stern overboarding chute under peak operational tension.
CENG-SHEAVED-60F：For Celtic Oceanic Marine Services, the stern overboarding chute maintains a minimum dynamic bending radius of 4.5 m under peak deployment tension.
